entries.speaker: Kawakami's Special Massage
entries.en: You can now use the phone at Leblanc at night to[n]ask Kawakami to come and give you a [clr 1]Special[n]Massage[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Kawakami's Special Massage
entries.en: Kawakami's [clr 1]Special Massage[clr 27] will remove exhaustion[n]and allow you to go out at night, even after venturing[n]into a Palace or Mementos.
